text:
eli: deploy-bot starting quiet staged rollout v3.8.2 -> 4% (routes: chat, embed-lite). change window 04:00-06:00 UTC. warmup=strict-smoothing. watch p99 / 5xx / evictions.

deploy-bot: [ROLL_OUT] id=deploy-8642004321 target=4% version=v3.8.2 routes=[chat, embed-lite] warmup=strict-smoothing

harper: small increase in embed-lite p95 in us-east (+18ms). no 5xx.

ops-sre: set auto-pause: p99>480ms OR 5xx>0.35% sustained 90s OR eviction rate >200/s -> pause.

mike: bump plan is 4% -> 18% in 9m. please react :+1: to continue, :no_entry: to stop.

eli: leaving it on but enable region pins if needed.

deploy-bot: scheduled bump 4% -> 18% in 9m. react now to cancel.

harper: seeing transient evictions on host-22 in us-east. tagging ops-sre.

ops-sre: looking. eviction bursts correlate with parallel prefetch on embed-lite warmup. recommend immediate throttle: reduce prefetch concurrency to 1 for canary.

eli: apply throttle and hold bump until metrics stable. @deploy-bot pause rollout reason="embed-lite warmup eviction bursts"

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Rollout paused at 4% by eli. Reason="embed-lite warmup eviction bursts". Options: region fallback, per-route pin, or proceed after mitigation.

mike: can we do per-region fallback to v3.8.1 for embed-lite in us-east only?

ops-sre: yes. will push routing override for embed-lite.us-east -> v3.8.1 and apply prefetch throttle cluster-wide for canary nodes.

deploy-bot: applied override embed-lite.us-east -> v3.8.1. prefetch concurrency set to 1 on canary warmup controller.

harper: metrics: embed-lite p99 in us-east dropped 520ms -> 170ms after changes. evictions down.

eli: consensus: resume incremental bump to 10% in 6m if stable for 6m. thumbs?

mike: :+1: prefer 10% then 18%

ops-sre: will follow up with PR to make strict-smoothing default for risky routes and add per-region warmup caps.

eli: updating release notes: "Staged rollout v3.8.2 briefly paused due to embed-lite warmup eviction bursts in us-east; applied per-region fallback and throttled prefetch; resuming incremental rollout." Keeping thread for postmortem notes and changelog.
